title: kbmon's cost line says it counts only kb-logged usage rows, not the day's total spend
goal: kbmon's cost line names what it sums (the usage rows and sidecars ql_report.usage_today reads, written only for prompts that used the kb or sit in a work window, never the running prompt) and is not headed as a day total: on 2026-11-08 'Cost today: $4.40 over 4 usage rows, 10.9M tokens' was printed while backlog.py cost gave ST-dmon53is about 11.6M and ST-rodj5ltd about 7.1M tokens, and 25 minutes later the same line read $8.46 and 27.1M with no matching jump in work. The line reads 'Logged cost today' with the rows' count. A true day total over every transcript is out of scope here (ST-m6pyyyw6 attributes distilled usage).

run: import subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--status','cost','--timeout','60'],capture_output=True,text=True);sys.exit(r.returncode not in (0,1) or 'Cost today:' in r.stdout or 'logged' not in r.stdout)
